keyword: when do the nhl playoffs start
claims: The 2026 NHL Stanley Cup playoffs are scheduled to begin on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The NHL regular season concludes on April 16, 2026.
The first round begins immediately after the regular season concludes.
The Stanley Cup Final is expected to end by June 21, 2026.
The 16 teams are the top three in each division plus two wild cards per conference.
The playoffs are played in a best-of-seven format.
Games will be broadcast on ESPN, TNT Sports, Sportsnet, and TVA Sports.
First-round matchups are finalized following the conclusion of the regular season on April 16, 2026.
